verdict.label: STEP ASIDE — Brent Crosses $97, XLE Stub Covered; 30Y Holds Day-1; AVGO AH Guidance Miss Weighs on Semis
verdict.rationale_short: The morning STEP ASIDE call was correct — the S&P 500 fell 0.74% and the Dow shed 621 points as Brent closed at $97.90, crossing the $97 mandatory XLE stub cover trigger. ADP (122K) landed in the base-case range; ISM Services printed 54.5% with the Prices Index hitting 71.3%, the highest reading since August 2022. The 30Y held at 4.965% (Day-1 sub-5.0% confirmed), preventing the full two-condition BEARISH trigger from firing. AVGO's after-hours Q3 AI guidance miss ($16B vs. $17.2B expected) is the first crack in the AI acceleration narrative. STEP ASIDE maintained at medium conviction; Friday's May NFP is the decisive binary.

trade_setups.thesis: The XLE short stub was covered today per the mandatory trigger: Brent closed at $97.90. The Iran escalation framework has shifted from 'hedge against resolution' to 'directional long thesis': ballistic missiles hit Kuwait and Bahrain, a sea drone struck an oil tanker, US forces struck Qeshm Island. If Brent closes above $97 for two consecutive sessions — confirming $97 as support rather than resistance — a small, defined-risk long XLE position is warranted as the conflict re-embeds a structural oil risk premium.

bear_case: The most direct challenge to staying merely STEP ASIDE is the compounding of three simultaneous signals: Brent above $97 re-embedding oil inflation, the ISM Services Prices Index at 71.3% (highest since August 2022), and AVGO's first guidance miss vs. elevated AI expectations. The bond market's refusal to panic — the 30Y held at 4.965% despite oil at $97.90 — is the only constructive signal, and it depends on markets reading the geopolitical oil premium as transient. If that premise breaks (Iran sustains Brent above $100 for multiple sessions), the 30Y cannot hold sub-5.0% and the STEP ASIDE framework collapses to BEARISH. The S&P 500 at 7,553 on a 22.66x forward PE is not priced for a scenario where AI runrate decelerates, oil stays elevated, and NFP Friday prints hot on top of an already-hot JOLTS. Invalidation: if Brent closes above $100 AND the 30Y closes above 5.05% on the same session, exit all longs — STEP ASIDE cannot hold that combination.
